title: Paid human responsibility-layer scan — Pizhou garlic broker deep check
purpose: Search smaller Xuzhou/Jiangsu private markets where counterparties repeatedly pay a human coordinator after direct contact because that person owns execution responsibility. Test whether the strongest current example, Pizhou garlic brokerage, leaves a post-incumbent Rooter residual.
scan_rule: HUMAN CONTROL PLANE CAN BE THE INCUMBENT
A NEW ROOTER LAYER REQUIRES A FAILURE AFTER THE CURRENT BROKER / MARKET / DIGITAL ROUTES ARE CONSIDERED
Do not preserve a candidate by inventing multi-broker replacement, independent acceptance or escrow needs without observed buyer pressure.

buyer_pull: Current 51garlic pages contain specific buy requests for Pizhou garlic with quantity, size, dryness, defect and target-price requirements.
Current Pizhou market reports describe purchasing by existing/old buyers and small-batch replenishment.
Current market quotations show active spot trade by standardized diameter/grade.
supply_and_broker_hunger: Current named Pizhou broker pages advertise long-running supply and one-stop agency services.
Named broker 徐建华 advertises procurement/storage/sale and deep-processing/export one-stop service and welcomes new and old clients.
Named broker 聂新永 advertises more than ten years of procurement/sale/storage service for domestic and foreign buyers.
Another current Pizhou agent advertises procurement, shipment, processing and packaging with its own site and cold storage.
why_brokers_remain_paid: The broker is not merely introducing counterparties; the broker physically executes local procurement and delivery tasks.
The recurring unit can include sourcing, lot assembly, grading/selection, processing, packaging, cold storage, loading/shipment and local problem resolution.
Current Mysteel Pizhou price notes continue to exclude broker/agency fees from commodity prices, showing agency cost remains a distinct transaction component.
Historical Mysteel cost accounting quantified broker fees separately; the historical amount is not used as a current price.
acceptance_and_standardization: National garlic grading standards are in force.
Pizhou has implemented local net-garlic procurement rules and 2026 sorting-machine aperture disclosure / transparent pricing measures.

2026 local government reporting says the rules have become broadly accepted market practice and a garlic transaction information platform publishes collection-point prices, inventory and labor demand.
No strong public post-standardization evidence was found that grade disputes remain a current unresolved systemic residual.

digital_and_market_incumbents.function: prices, buy/sell posts, broker directory, market live pages, warehouse/logistics information and direct phone/WeChat contact
digital_and_market_incumbents.boundary: Public pages largely route counterparties to direct contact rather than clearly replacing the local broker's physical execution responsibility.

digital_and_market_incumbents.function: current collection-point price, inventory and labor-demand transparency
digital_and_market_incumbents.boundary: Reduces information asymmetry; does not by itself prove full execution/settlement replacement.
Shows local supply-chain digitization is already progressing.

digital_and_market_incumbents.function: guarantee/deposit mechanisms, designated warehouses, third-party quality inspection, fund custody, electronic settlement and delivery rules
digital_and_market_incumbents.boundary: Demonstrates that grading/escrow/settlement control-plane functions are already technically and commercially productized in the garlic vertical.

digital_and_market_incumbents.function: online inquiry, lot attributes, video/on-site acceptance, transaction support
digital_and_market_incumbents.boundary: Some platforms explicitly market removing the middleman; public pages may still leave funds to bilateral safe settlement.

rooter_execution_map_if_forced.actor_a: remote wholesale buyer / cold-storage trader / processor / exporter with specific Pizhou garlic purchase mandate
rooter_execution_map_if_forced.actor_b: local farmers/storage holders plus broker/processing/cold-storage/logistics execution nodes
rooter_execution_map_if_forced.minimum_task_unit: one procurement mandate defined by origin, grade/diameter, quantity, price band, processing/packaging, acceptance rate, delivery and payment timing
rooter_execution_map_if_forced.acceptance: grade/diameter, weight, defect tolerance, packaging, pass rate, photos/video or third-party inspection where required
rooter_execution_map_if_forced.payer: buyer pays commodity price plus local agency/processing/storage/logistics charges
rooter_execution_map_if_forced.rooter_possible_role: standardized intake, verified broker routing, live availability, milestone evidence, performance history, replacement and settlement evidence
rooter_execution_map_if_forced.rooter_must_not: buy/speculate on garlic, hold inventory, operate cold storage, personally grade/pack, become commodity trader

strongest_pattern.reason: Pizhou garlic strongly validates the doctrine that a paid intermediary survives when it owns recurring local execution responsibility. But the current broker is already that control plane. Digital information, grading standards, warehouses and electronic settlement/QC routes are also expanding around it. No post-incumbent buyer failure was observed that requires an additional Rooter layer. A new router would mostly add broker discovery/routing and would be bypassed once a buyer establishes a trusted broker relationship.

human_probe.reason: Public evidence does not expose a narrow post-incumbent residual. Calling brokers to ask why buyers still pay them would deepen understanding of an incumbent model, not confirm a high-information Rooter gap.

material_learning: Pizhou garlic is a strong real-world example of a human control plane: brokers remain paid because they execute local responsibility, not because they merely know both sides.
A human control plane can itself be the mature incumbent.
Digitizing discovery around an incumbent broker does not create durable Rooter value when repeat buyer-broker relationships are direct and bypass risk is high.

The next search must find responsibility currently paid to a human coordinator where the coordinator function is fragmented/replacement-sensitive and no mature vertical control plane or stable direct relationship already owns it.
scan_conclusion.current_best_next_truth: Fresh Scan 021 should search for recurring human responsibility layers with weak individual persistence: buyers repeatedly need someone to guarantee outcome/replacement, but the specific coordinator/provider is interchangeable or frequently unavailable. That structure can justify routing history/replacement value. Avoid commodity brokerage where one trusted local agent naturally becomes the durable relationship.
